caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a hand drill or brace, commonly used in woodworking. The tool is composed primarily of wood with a metal component at one end. The wood is rendered in light to medium brown tones with darker shading to indicate texture and depth, while the metal part is shown in a dull grayish-green shade, featuring a flat side with a bolt or screw indicated. The handle has a sinuous, angular “S” shape, and at the far right end, there is a rounded, turned wooden knob for gripping, depicted in a darker brown with wood grain lines visible. The background is off-white and unadorned, showing some visible aging spots. Near the center-right of the drawing, there is small, neat handwriting of the name “Violet Hartenstein.”
title: Brace (Wooden)
